incident.cause: Full-width slider and checkable-row rectangles excluded every horizontal lane even when the proposed swipe did not intersect their vertical bounds.

fix.path_selection: Choose a bounded vertical segment in a free interval of the observed viewport; avoid padded control and overlay rectangles along both axes.
fix.safety: Reject if no segment fits; preserve exact target bounds and package/window checks; retain existing bounded retries and fresh observation after reveal.

device_font_reveal.preparation: Move toward the top edge within the observed list; await native gesture completion callbacks. The bottom edge cannot be prepared by backward scrolling when the list is already at its start.

deployment.compatibility_build: Temporary Gradle finalizeDsl override retained installed com.click identity; repository default com.clueclick.app unchanged.
deployment.verification_isolation: Independent test package avoids replacing the other ongoing task's test APK; no production app reinstall during the unlocked-device verification.
